title: Python Numbers: Integers, Floats, Complex, Decimal
author: Glenn Junsay Pansensoy
excerpt: Learn Python numbers free with 16 runnable programs: integers, floats, complex, math, random, Decimal and Fraction, line by line.
body: Numbers are the foundation of almost everything you will build in Python, from calculators and games to financial software and data analysis. In this video tutorial you will learn every numeric type in Python and the tools that go with them, with each program shown next to its real output. 1.1 Creating Integers 1.2 Arbitrary Precision 2.1 Creating Floats 2.2 Special Float Values 3.1 Creating Complex Numbers 3.2 Complex Number Functions 4.1 Basic Operators 4.2 Augmented Assignment 5.1 Common math Functions 5.2 Constants and Special Functions 6.1 Basic Random Functions 6.2 Seeding for Reproducibility 7.1 Decimal: Exact Decimal Arithmetic 7.2 Fraction: Rational Numbers 8.1 Formatting Floats 8.2 Formatting Integers Pause the video, run every example yourself, and change the values to see what happens. The full interactive lesson, with a code runner for every program and a line-by-line explanation, is here: Python Numbers on Poetic Bytes. If this tutorial helped you, please like and subscribe, and share it with someone who is learning Python.
